title: Create a project
summary: Interactively scaffold a new BornEngine project.
behavior: Prompts for the project name, package manager, and stable engine version. It refuses to overwrite populated or conflicting files.

title: Create a project non-interactively
summary: Scaffold a project from a script or CI job.
behavior: Uses explicit arguments instead of prompts and refuses to overwrite populated or conflicting files.

title: Initialize the current directory
summary: Scaffold BornEngine files in the current project directory.
behavior: Initializes a project without taking a project-name argument. Existing conflicting files are protected.

title: Build a game
summary: Compile a TypeScript entry file for a target platform.
behavior: Writes build artifacts under .bornengine/builds/. Web and mobile targets are build-only; they do not run through the native run command.

title: Build and run locally
summary: Build a native executable and launch it on the current host.
options: Arguments after -- are passed to the game
behavior: Runs a native executable for the current host. Web and mobile outputs are build-only and require their platform workflow.

title: Develop with a watch loop
summary: Build during development and optionally rebuild when files change.
behavior: Watch mode uses .perry-dev/ for its development artifacts. Use a native target for a local executable.

title: Check a project
summary: Validate a TypeScript entry file without producing a runnable build.
behavior: Runs the project's checks for the selected target and reports errors without launching the game.

title: Clean generated artifacts
summary: Remove BornEngine-generated build and development artifacts.
behavior: Removes tracked artifacts such as .bornengine/builds/ and development output. It does not delete source files.

title: Inspect the local setup
summary: Check the tools and environment needed by BornEngine.
behavior: Reports setup checks and points to the first failing dependency. Run it before diagnosing a build failure.

title: Show project information
summary: Print the project and selected engine configuration.
behavior: Displays information useful for support reports without changing the project.

title: Print the CLI version
summary: Show the installed BornEngine CLI version.
behavior: Prints the CLI version and exits without touching project files.

title: Show the selected engine
summary: Print the engine version or path currently selected by the project.
behavior: Reads the active engine selection without changing it.

title: Install an engine version
summary: Install a BornEngine engine release for later selection.
options: [version] selects a release; omit it for the CLI's default
behavior: Adds an engine version to the local engine store. Installation does not implicitly rewrite the project's selected version.

title: List installed engines
summary: Show engine versions available in the local engine store.
behavior: Lists installed versions and identifies the active selection when one exists.

title: Update installed engine releases
summary: Refresh or update engine versions in the local store.
behavior: Updates engine installation metadata without changing the CLI binary itself.

title: Remove an engine version
summary: Delete an installed engine version from the local store.
behavior: Removes a stored version. Check engine current and project configuration before deleting an active version.

title: Select an engine source
summary: Choose an installed version or a local engine path for the project.
options: <version-or-path> can identify an installed release or local path
behavior: Changes the engine source used by subsequent project commands.

title: Upgrade the CLI
summary: Install a newer BornEngine CLI release.
behavior: Runs the CLI upgrade flow for a selected release. Use update when you only want to check for a newer CLI release.

title: Check for CLI updates
summary: Check the release channel without silently replacing the CLI.
behavior: Checks for a newer CLI release and prints the installation command. It does not self-update the binary.

title: Set a CLI configuration value
summary: Persist a named BornEngine CLI configuration value.
options: <value> is stored as the selected value
behavior: Writes a configuration value used by subsequent CLI operations.

title: Read a CLI configuration value
summary: Print the current value for one configuration key.
behavior: Reads one configuration key without changing it.

title: List CLI configuration
summary: Print the configuration values currently known to the CLI.
behavior: Lists configuration keys and values to make project setup easier to inspect.
